title: LEO Failover Saturation Follow-up
primary_claim: Distinguish the Table 1 capacity ceiling from the initial 200000-terminal result
primary_configuration: Config A, uncapped GCB, coordinated beams, no incumbents; 2000000 requested terminals for temporal summary
sampling: Four terminal budgets (500000, 1000000, 2000000, 4000000) at t=0, 2000000 terminals at all 15 adjacent seconds; artifact GCB variant at 4000000, t=0
comparison_rule: Signed relative difference from Table 1 and the original predeclared ±5% numerical threshold. Report terminal-budget convergence separately; do not infer a ceiling unless the largest tested budgets agree.
uncertainty: Deterministic time-state ranges, no inferential intervals or independent replications
corrections: Reuse the exact original runner, graph corrections, beam mapping and gateway provisioning. Allocation variants retain their declared differences.
limitations: This follow-up was designed after inspecting the initial campaign; it is exploratory and does not replace the original frozen design.
A plateau across tested budgets is evidence of numerical saturation at tested epochs, not a global optimum proof.
Capacity remains an optimistic simulated downlink bound, not observed operational satellite traffic.
